name: Numazu

queries.query: Numazu City official cadastral parcel map GIS land parcel map Japan
queries.result: First-party discovery found Numazu City's official development-guidance page identifying a municipal cadastral-survey section, and the city's official cadastral-map-copy request/FAQ pages. The city also publishes urban-planning maps, but no anonymous municipal cadastral parcel API was exposed. The G-Space CKAN catalog provides an anonymous municipality extract for Numazu (code 22203).

sourceAssessment.officialCityService: Numazu City official cadastral-survey section and cadastral-map-copy application/FAQ; the city's public online urban-planning map is not a verified cadastral parcel API.
sourceAssessment.localRegistryProcedure: Numazu City states that its cadastral-survey section performs parcel-level cadastral work and that anyone may request a copy of a cadastral map by place/lot at the city counter for a fee. This evidences local custody/procedure, not an anonymous citywide runtime service.
sourceAssessment.openGeometrySource: G-Space CKAN package aigid-moj-22203, an anonymous Ministry of Justice registry-office map extract for Numazu municipality code 22203. The 2026 resource URL returned a GeoJSON FeatureCollection with 31,430 Polygon features and native ID field ID; its FeatureCollection name says 2025.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official page identifies the Numazu City cadastral-survey section and describes its parcel-level survey remit; no parcel API exposed.
Official FAQ says anyone may request a cadastral-map copy by place/lot at the city counter and gives the fee; no public geometry endpoint.
Official online urban-planning summary map; explicitly not a legally certifying document and not verified as cadastral geometry.
Catalog metadata returned Numazu code 22203 GeoJSON/SHP resources for 2022-2026 and source field metadata.

Fetched to ignored scratch; FeatureCollection name says 2025, contains 31,430 Polygon features, uses CRS84 and native ID field ID. A bounded exact-point intersection check at [35.1153877559585, 138.891184277782] returned zero features; no geometry retained.

blocker: Official local custody/procedure and a public source extract were evidenced, but no public city viewer parcel API was qualified, citywide completeness was not verified, and the exact-point bounded test returned zero features. Runtime integration remains held.
remainingUncertainty: The city public map's current JavaScript/configuration was not found to expose cadastral geometry; the source resource label 2026 conflicts with its FeatureCollection name 2025; and zero exact-point intersection cannot establish absence or completeness. No owner, address, lot, title, tax, or personal fields were requested or retained.
nextStep: If runtime qualification is required, inspect any current official Numazu map viewer configuration and independently validate adapter behavior and coverage; retain only stable public IDs and geometry.
